scope_review.relation_rationale: The selected primary report explicitly defines its primary composite as the first occurrence of cardiovascular death, nonfatal MI, or nonfatal stroke, analyzed time-to-event. This matches the requested component set and first-event estimand during trial follow-up. Its primary ITT comparison is extended-release exenatide 2 mg weekly versus matching placebo, reported as HR 0.91 (95% CI 0.83 to 1.00); the coprimary hypotheses were noninferiority for safety and superiority for efficacy. The article identifies EXSCEL as NCT01144338, while captured intake metadata declares NCT01455896. Registry retrieval was unavailable, so applicability to the conflicting intake identifier remains unresolved; I do not silently reconcile these identifiers.
